rawFindings.claim: findCommentByMarker has an unreachable final ambiguous return after the early-exit guard
rawFindings.description: The paginated loop has an early-exit `if (matches.length >= 2) { return { ambiguous: true, comments: matches }; }` inside the while loop. After the loop, the code checks `matches.length === 0` (null) and `matches.length === 1` (update), then falls through to a final `return { ambiguous: true, comments: matches }`. Because the early exit already handles the >= 2 case, the post-loop code can only reach matches.length of 0 or 1, making the final ambiguous return dead code. This is not a bug (it's a safe fallback), but it is unreachable and could confuse future maintainers into thinking the loop could exit with 2+ matches without the early return firing.

proof.summary: The while loop contains an unconditional early return when matches.length >= 2 (line 83-85). The loop can only exit via break (triggered by comments.length < PER_PAGE) when matches.length < 2. Therefore the post-loop final return { ambiguous: true } (line ~96) is unreachable.
